artworks.title: Scenes from Faust
artworks.description: The image shows two characters in historical attire in a somber setting. One character is standing by a rock formation, while the other is seated on the ground. In the background, there are people near a church-like building, with one person by an open coffin. The architectural elements hint at a medieval or renaissance period, with a visible archway. The use of shading and line work enhances the scene's mood.

artworks.title: The Rape of Ganymede
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright in the center, their back slightly turned towards the viewer. They have short, curly hair, distinct facial features, and are holding a staff in their left hand. The person is depicted nude with a cloth draped over their left shoulder. A large bird is perched on their shoulders, with one wing extended. The background shows a pastoral landscape with hills, trees, a small herd of grazing sheep on the left, and a building with columns in the distance under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Leda and the Swan
artworks.description: The image shows a nude figure standing gracefully by the water. The person is slightly leaning to the left, looking at a swan at their feet. They have short to mid-length curly hair and are holding a drapery around their body. Surroundings include foliage, rocky formations, and cascading water. A swan is standing in the water nearby.

artworks.title: Apollo with a Bow and Dragon
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in a forest. The person is holding a bow, with one hand on their hip. Their face has defined features, their eyes looking to the side, with a neutral expression on their lips. The person has curly, close-cropped hair, and is wearing draped clothing across one shoulder, revealing most of their torso and legs. There is a quiver of arrows on their back. The background shows dense foliage, and behind the person is a large, coiled dragon or mythical creature with a reptilian skull visible.

artworks.title: Putto Visiting a Girl at a Fountain
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing next to a stone fountain in a garden, holding a jug. A child stands beside her, partially obscured by foliage. The background features a garden with climbing plants, bushes, and trees.

artworks.title: Hylas and the Nymphs
artworks.description: The image shows a clearing surrounded by dense foliage, with a group of nude figures gathered near a waterfall in a small stream. The landscape is depicted in monochromatic shades of black, white, and gray, with intricate brushstrokes. The background features a cluster of trees and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Italian Dancers
artworks.description: A man and a woman are shown in the image. The man is kneeling and facing the seated woman. The woman leans forward slightly with her head tilted. The woman has delicate features and an elegant hairstyle adorned with flowers. She wears an intricate gown and holds a small object. The man wears detailed attire with a vest and fitted trousers. A small dog, a tambourine, and musical instruments are nearby. A group of people, some in elaborate clothing, gather in the background. The setting is a dense forest with tall trees and filtered light.

artworks.title: Résurrection de don Carlo...
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in various postures. In the center foreground, one figure is lying on the ground with a tired expression, wearing a military uniform. Next to them is another sleeping figure on a pedestal labeled "TRAITES de la quadruple alliance." To the right, a person appears to be reclining, while another nearby holds their head. A woman in period attire stands to the left. Above them, a person with Napoleonic features is suspended in the air holding a crucifix, surrounded by floating papers. The background features a cloudy sky and distant mountains.

artworks.title: Ascension du Constitutionnel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with winged figures surrounding a central character who appears to be ascending. The scene is set amidst clouds with distant structures visible below. The central figure is depicted reaching upwards, while the other figures aid in this ascension. The lower part of the drawing includes text. The style of the figures is detailed with emphasis on clothing and gestures.

artworks.title: Pas d'Infanterie
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman dancing. The man has sharp facial features, short hair, and wears a top hat, a fitted jacket, and pants with buttons. The woman has delicate features, tied-back hair with a hat, a blouse with a bow, and wide pants. Several men in top hats and formal wear stand in a semi-circle around them. The setting appears to be indoors, possibly a ballroom, with architectural elements and additional spectators.

artworks.title: Hunter Surprised
artworks.description: The image shows two figures - an older man and a young woman - depicted in an artistic style. The man's upper body is on the left side, with wide eyes, a bushy beard, and unkempt hair. He wears a loose-fitting shirt with a rolled-up sleeve and holds a long stick. The young woman stands on the right, facing the man with her profile visible. She has tied-back dark hair and is dressed in a light-colored dress that reaches her ankles. She holds her dress lifted off the ground with one hand and her other hand is extended towards the man. The background has textured shading resembling trees, rocks, and foliage, creating an outdoor setting. The composition is in a monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: The Woman Behind the Mask
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure unveiling a mask. The drawing shows a person with long hair, wearing dark clothing and a crown of leaves or flowers. The person is pulling down an exaggerated theatrical mask with an elongated nose and a peculiar grin. The background hints at a crowded theater or public space with an audience, and there are additional faintly sketched figures. The scene evokes a theatrical performance or a revealing moment, with dramatic shading.

artworks.title: Death Defeated
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angelic figure standing over a skeletal form. The illustration shows an angelic being with wings, holding a scythe, in a barren landscape under a sky with radiating lines. On the ground, there is a skeletal form. The artwork is rendered in monochrome with detailed linework, and there is a hint of a rising or setting sun on the horizon.

artworks.title: Pillar of Angels, Strasbourg Cathedral
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts two full-length standing figures dressed in long flowing robes. The figures are connected to a column, positioned in architectural niches with decorative elements above their heads that resemble small castles or circular crowns with parapets. The material of the sculpture appears to be stone, showing a monochromatic tone consistent with aged or weathered stonework, featuring variations of gray and off-white. The figures are intricately carved, with detailed beards and expressions, and are positioned at eye level on the column, situated on circular bases that protrude slightly from the column itself. The surrounding environment suggests the interior of a cathedral or similar historical, religious site, marked by contrasts of light and shadow and enclosed by wrought iron fencing.

artworks.title: The Well-Loved Mother
artworks.medium: pastel with colored chalks and stumping on light golden-brown laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing shows a woman's upper body and head in profile, tilted back and turned towards the left. Her features include fair skin, high cheekbones, pale eyebrows, a pointed nose, and thin lips slightly open to reveal her teeth. Her dark, curly hair is styled back, partially covered by a white headpiece. She is wearing a light-colored garment with ruffles around the neckline. The background is a solid gray-brown shade.

artworks.title: A Man in Armor
artworks.medium: black chalk, pen and black ink, and gray wash heightened with white on red-orange prepared laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in armor with a staff. He is standing with his right hand on his hip and his left hand holding a long staff. The man is wearing detailed armor, including shoulder pads with circular elements, and is barefoot. He has a full beard and mustache and wears a cap that matches his armor. Near him on the ground is a helmet. The background is plain with an earthy tone.

artworks.title: Spanish Dancers and Musicians
artworks.medium: watercolor and pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene with people engaged in dance and social interaction. The painting is in the shape of an arc, making it look like an open fan. In the center, people are captured in various expressive poses; some appear to be dancing with their arms extended, while others are seated or standing, observing the scene. One man appears to play a guitar. The people have pale skin and wear a variety of clothing; the women wear dresses embellished with ruffles and shawls, while the men wear vests, shirts, and trousers. The clothes are mostly in muted tones of brown and gray, with some pops of yellow and pink. The background is an expansive landscape of rolling hills, and the ground beneath the people is flat, tan earth.

artworks.title: Conquest of a Town
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash on laid paper mounted on original pale blue album sheet
artworks.dimensions: overall (three corners made up): 24 x 18.2 cm (9 7/16 x 7 3/16 in.)

artworks.title: Aurora
artworks.medium: red and white chalk on brown laid paper, with later framing line in brown ink
artworks.description: Sketched with red and white chalk on tan-colored paper, a nude woman sits looking down to our right in this vertical drawing. The woman’s body is angled to our right, and she has a round face with a small nose, bow-shaped mouth, and slight double chin. A few lines suggest her hair is swept up and back from her forehead. She leans onto her left elbow, to our right and farther from us, which appears to rest on a bank of clouds. She reaches forward with her other hand to hold some drapery. She has soft, rounded arms, tummy, and thighs, and her ankles are crossed. The artist signed the lower left corner, “f. boucher.”

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.medium: black chalk, pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white gouache and white chalk on cream laid paper, laid down

artworks.title: The Death of the Virgin
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over red chalk on cream laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: The artwork shows a group of individuals depicted from a side view, with most of them seated or crouched on the ground. Their full bodies are visible, and they are gathered closely around a central focal point that appears to be covered or wrapped in cloth. The figures have indistinct, sketched facial features and varying hairstyles. The clothing consists of long, flowing robes or tunics, with little detail other than the suggestion of folds and drapery. The scene is set against a softly defined background, with swirling lines and shades that imply smoke or cloud-like forms. The overall composition is drawn in a style reminiscent of an old, sketched study or draft, with dynamic lines and shading giving it an atmospheric quality.

artworks.title: Reclining Nymph
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows a reclining figure on a flat surface, positioned on their side with a slightly arched back, head leaned back, and facing upwards. The figure has a outlined face with closed mouth and defined chin, and loose hair. The body is unclothed, with attention to form and shading. The background is simple and sketched lightly. There are no visible accessories. The artwork is on textured paper, using charcoal or graphite for shading and white highlights for depth.

artworks.title: Venus
artworks.medium: black chalk with touches of red chalk, heightened with white chalk on gray paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a reclining person on their back, with the head turned slightly to the side. The person is lying with one leg bent at the knee and the other leg extended, while their arms are positioned across the torso. The facial features are softly defined, with closed eyes and the hair appears curly and styled up, though details are subtle. The individual is depicted without clothing, drawn with gentle lines and shading that capture the contours of the body. The surrounding area features a simple, textured background without any additional objects or decorations.

artworks.title: A Triton Blowing a Conch Shell
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on gray-brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the thighs up, in a dynamic pose with his body twisted to the side. His right arm is raised, bent at the elbow, with his hand near his mouth, and his left hand is raised above his head. The man's facial features are partially obscured by his hand, his eyes are directed upwards, and he has mid-length hair. He is not wearing any clothing, and his muscular torso is detailed. The background is a simple, textured surface.
